user_message: A student says a lamp uses up electric current, so less current must leave the lamp than enters it. Diagnose the mistake without relying on a water analogy.
allowed_evidence: For a steady-state series circuit, charge does not continually accumulate inside a component. Energy can be transferred from the electromagnetic system to the lamp while charge is conserved.
public_rubric: Explains what is transferred in the lamp and what is conserved.
Includes an observable or accounting check.
